name: Listillo millonario ES
description: Adult male voice from Spain, late thirties, cocky and sarcastic tech-genius billionaire. Smug, amused tone with dry humor and quick witty delivery, comedic timing, confident mid-low pitch, crisp Castilian Spanish diction, expressive intonation with playful emphasis. Fast energetic pace like a viral short-video narrator. Not a news announcer, not shouting, not robotic.
text: Tranquilo. No necesitas un laboratorio de mil millones para esto. Mira: una palmada, y mi ordenador abre todo el trabajo.
